subject: house spider
title: What If You Really Swallowed Spiders in Your Sleep?

scenes.text: What if you swallow eight spiders a year in your sleep? Even the story behind it is fake.
Spider experts say there isn't a single case of it in scientific or medical records.
To a spider, a sleeping person is a huge danger. Your breathing and heartbeat send out vibrations, and spiders sense vibrations.
A typical bed may see only one or two spiders cross it in a whole year.
The famous origin, a 1993 magazine inventing the stat to fool readers? Snopes made that up in 2001, as a prank.
The fake author's name was an anagram of this is a big troll. A fake fact, about a fake fact.

description:
What if you swallowed spiders in your sleep? The claim that people swallow eight spiders a year has no support: the Burke Museum's arachnid curator Rod Crawford says there is no recorded case, and spiders avoid sleeping humans, whose breathing and heartbeat create vibrations spiders read as danger.
The popular origin story, a 1993 PC Professional column by Lisa Birgit Holst, was itself invented by Snopes in 2001; the name is an anagram of this is a big troll.
